prose: Author and eternal athlete Al Dawg joins Vibe Rant to talk about his new book, The Sharter: A Millennial Journey Out of Hip-Hop Hypnosis. What has the psychological operation known as gangster rap done to the younger generations, and how can comedy help us pull the mentally enslaved back from the hellish simulation that is modern music?
